proposer_identity_completion.quotient_boundary: Identity permutations may be collapsed only downstream for an exactly equal H-payoff vector, preserving every source ID and hash.

coordinates.conditional_means: bar_Y_L and bar_Y_P are recognition- and strategy-weighted means within nonempty L and P categories

nu0_reporting.full_image: Enumerate every value induced by the correspondence, including k/m pure identity shares and continuous slices generated only by valid within-assessment L/D mixing.
nu0_reporting.interpretation: These are reporting coordinates, not primitives, equilibrium-selection weights, empirical frequencies, or the equal-area measure over outside options.

strategy_profile.downstream_transport: N6 must preserve the complete parameterized record and every linked source assessment. N7 may quotient only exactly equal H-payoff vectors while retaining source IDs and hashes.

belief_system.entry: nu=Pr(theta=1) before a weak proposer is recognized
belief_system.positive_weight_proposal: Because the weak proposer does not observe theta, Bayes preserves nu at every on-path proposal.
belief_system.weak_action_passivity: At an on-path ballot, every weak action is type-independent; observing weak votes adds no information beyond the proposal and prior public history.
belief_system.public_H_vote: H's published vote updates the posterior when its on-path strategy differs by type; every positive-probability failure vector uses Bayes.
belief_system.on_path_delay: A nonrevealing delay has posterior nu<=nu_star and consumes N2-EQ-LOW-TYPE-ONLY, including equality.
belief_system.zero_weight_proposal: The ballot belief after a zero-probability proposal is an explicit free component in [0,1].
belief_system.zero_probability_failure_vector: Each zero-probability public vote vector has its own explicit posterior eta in [0,1] and consumes the N2 record determined by eta.
belief_system.zero_prior_types: At nu=0 or nu=1, strategies and sequential rationality for the zero-probability type remain specified; Bayes constrains only positive-probability histories.
belief_system.completeness: No belief is inferred merely from branch labels; the assessment contains the proposal belief and the continuation posterior for every public failure vector.

equilibrium_records.existence_uniqueness_status: Exists because pooling is nonempty. The correspondence is generally neither strategy-unique nor payoff-unique; conditional nonexistence applies only to explicitly certified candidate families.
equilibrium_records.selection_status: No equilibrium, identity, branch, package, ballot, belief, continuation, or distribution over equilibria is selected. All admissible pure families, linked assessments, proposal mixtures, slack packages, and labeled identity assignments are retained. The proposal-level tie-break uses H_tie only when r_i=S_2; nonattained security components are not converted into fictitious deviations. Stage-undominance precedes T^Y, and the only permitted downstream collapse is the source-preserving exact H-payoff quotient.

exact_proposer_security.implication: No proposal forces passage when m-1>=2; coordinated weak vetoes survive stage-undominance.

ballot_response_map_after_every_feasible.continuation_inputs: Each failure vector explicitly records eta and thereby one of the two frozen N2 records; no common-continuation shortcut is imposed.
